newsitem.title: USA: Labor Ready names Charles Russell CFO.
newsitem.headline: Labor Ready names Charles Russell CFO.

text.p: Labor Ready Inc said it appointed Charles Russell, former vice president finance of DAKA International Inc's DAKA Restaurants Inc and vice president finance and treasurer of Heartland Food Systems Inc, as chief financial officer.
Russell replaces Ralph Peterson, who was previously appointed to the new position as executive vice president and chief operating officer of Labor Ready Inc.
Russell had served since 1995 as vice president of finance of DAKA Restaurants, a $300 million Massachusetts-based food service company.
